regions.today: Mainly dry this evening, but possibly a few heavy showers later, in light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Rather cloudy and humid tonight with scattered showers. However, a clearance to fresher conditions will extend from the west by morning. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 17 degrees, in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Friday, will be a fresher day, with a fair deal of cloud around, but some sunny spells too. It'll be dry for most, with just a few isolated light showers around. Highest temperatures will range from 19 to 23 or 24 degrees, warmest in the southeast, in light to moderate northwest breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Thursday and Friday.
